review_limits: No paper draft was supplied. Per review protocol, claims-vs-code could not evaluate manuscript claims or reported linking statistics against text.

External census datasets and intermediate files on drives D: and F: ($REP_F, $REP_SNU) were unavailable in this sandbox, so empirical frequencies of empty or unilateral FamilySearch names could not be directly observed.
The Stata pipeline could not be executed in this read-only review environment. Behavior of Stata commands and abeclean.ado was verified by static source code analysis rather than live execution.

The review scope was targeted to uncommitted changes in the working tree (MATCHING/1b_fs_divided_files.do) and untracked review files; unchanged matching and append scripts were examined only for context.
summary: The uncommitted placeholder-row implementation in MATCHING/1b_fs_divided_files.do:72-82 cleanly prevents abeclean from crashing with r(2000) when a birthplace file has empty or non-alphabetic FamilySearch name fields, while ensuring complete isolation from master records through observation-level cleaning, explicit placeholder dropping, and an assert _N==`n0' count check. Fallback to Ancestry names and middle initials remains robust, and the placebo check structure is fully preserved. The next operational step is running MATCHING/check_placebo.do in the live Stata environment to verify exact pair-level replication of the baseline links.

verified_clean.evidence: In MATCHING/1b_fs_divided_files.do:72-82, appending a row with populated string literals ('john' and 'smith') and sex=1 guarantees that fs_namefrst and fs_namelast always contain valid alphabetic characters for abeclean's split call (LINKAGE/code/01_abe_jw/reference/abeclean.ado:231-235), avoiding r(2000) 'no observations' even when all original records in a file lack one or both names.
verified_clean.item: Placeholder row prevents abeclean r(2000) crash on empty or non-alphabetic FamilySearch name fields.

verified_clean.evidence: In MATCHING/1b_fs_divided_files.do:72-82, _placeholder is initialized to 0 for all existing rows, set to 1 for the added row, dropped via drop if _placeholder, and verified with assert _N==`n0' before any variables are assigned to master records.
verified_clean.item: Synthetic observation is cleanly dropped and original dataset count is strictly verified.

verified_clean.evidence: Traced LINKAGE/code/01_abe_jw/reference/abeclean.ado:153-400. Normalization, string manipulation, split, and nickname table merges (merge m:1 sex var using ...) operate strictly on individual observations without sorting, lag/lead referencing, or cross-observation aggregations affecting master rows.
verified_clean.item: Observation-independence of abeclean ensures no cross-record pollution from the placeholder row.

verified_clean.evidence: In MATCHING/1b_fs_divided_files.do:83-87, updates to f_name, l_name, and mi are conditioned on fs_frst_used (fs_namefrst_cleaned!='') and fs_last_used (fs_namelast_cleaned!=''). Original Ancestry values are untouched when FamilySearch fields are blank or uncleanable.
verified_clean.item: Fallback logic correctly preserves original Ancestry names and middle initials.

verified_clean.evidence: In MATCHING/1b_fs_divided_files.do:49-52, 83-87, when fstype is '_fsplacebo_cleaned', both FamilySearch fields are generated empty, fs_frst_used and fs_last_used evaluate to 0 for all original records, and all Ancestry names and initials remain intact. This is validated end-to-end by MATCHING/check_placebo.do:16-47.
verified_clean.item: Placebo run guarantees exact preservation of the Ancestry baseline.

verified_clean.evidence: In MATCHING/1b_fs_divided_files.do:46-58, input birthplace files are checked with isid id, merged 1:1 against fs_names<yr>.dta with keep(1 3), and verified with assert _N==`n0', ensuring zero unintended drops or duplicates from the merge.
verified_clean.item: Master record uniqueness and input integrity verified prior to name replacement.

verified_clean.evidence: Checked git status --short and git ls-files --others --exclude-standard. All untracked and modified files outside MATCHING/1b_fs_divided_files.do reside exclusively under review/reports/ and consist of JSON, log, and Markdown review reports.
verified_clean.item: All newly added and untracked files are non-code review artifacts.
